# FireRatShader (Paid)

By FireRat / FireRat666.

**Paid commercial Unity shader. Purchase is external; this listing does not include or redistribute the shader.**

- [Purchase / current pricing on Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/cw/FireRat)
- [Official website](https://shader.firer.at/)

In Community Plugins, **Source** opens the author's GitHub documentation. **Full instructions** opens this page with the purchase link. The app's “Instructions only” label means no downloadable package is hosted by this listing; the product itself is a shader.

The author describes Built-in and URP support, with testing on Unity 2022.3 LTS and Unity 6.3 LTS. These are author-reported claims, not independent catalogue testing. Follow the author's purchase, licence and installation instructions. Verify your project's pipeline and requirements before purchasing.

Catalogue version 0.1.0 identifies this directory listing, not the shader's release version.
